name: CHAOSS GrimoireLab

copied.note: The primary CHAOSS logo; media-and-outreach/brand-style-guide.md says the color logo should be used whenever possible.
The secondary reverse white logo the style guide provides, for the dark theme.
The GrimoireLab wizard, the mark docs/_includes/navigation.html shows as the site's navbar brand.

provenance.note: The GrimoireLab site stylesheet: --primary #003756, --secondary #2c3e50, link #003756, link hover #117964, body font Lato, heading font Montserrat, the monospace stack. Not served.
The logo's fills are the CHAOSS palette as exact values: #D50057, #009ADE, #66C9BA, #C19ADE, and #231F20 for the word mark.
The palette as an image: Pantone Rubine Red C, 2925 C, 570 C and Violet 0631 C. Its printed RGB values differ slightly from the logo's fills; the tokens use the fills. Not served.

The CHAOSS brand style guide: CHAOSS in capitals; the color logo whenever possible, reverse white and black where needed; clear space of the diameter of the logo's o; at least 0.75 in (54 px) wide; cite https://chaoss.community. Not served.
Section 8.4: project trademarks are owned by The Linux Foundation; section 7.2 asks participants to respect trademark owners' branding and usage guidelines. Not served.
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2017 chaoss: the license of chaoss/community, which holds the logos.
Apache License 2.0, the license of chaoss/grimoirelab's docs/ (the site, its stylesheet and the wizard). Section 6 grants no permission to use the licensor's trademarks.
GNU GPL 3.0, the license of the rest of chaoss/grimoirelab. Nothing outside docs/ is copied.

tokens.$description: CHAOSS GrimoireLab in W3C DTCG format. color.<name> sets the page variable --<name>; font.<name> sets --font-<name>. A $extensions dark value replaces the color in the dark theme; a color without one keeps the template's dark value.

brand.$description: CHAOSS rubine, the logo's first fill.

ring.$description: CHAOSS blue, the logo's second fill.

sans.$description: GrimoireLab body font stack, docs/css/styles.css. Lato itself is not served.

display.$description: GrimoireLab heading font stack, docs/css/styles.css. Montserrat itself is not served.

license.copied: The CHAOSS logos are from chaoss/community (MIT, Copyright (c) 2017 chaoss); the wizard is from chaoss/grimoirelab docs/ (Apache-2.0). The copyright notices travel with this lock.
license.trademark: CHAOSS is a Linux Foundation project, and its charter (section 8.4) assigns project trademarks to The Linux Foundation. Neither license grants trademark rights (Apache-2.0 section 6 says so). The brand style guide sets how the logo is used but does not grant permission to use it.
license.permission: Not established. Using the CHAOSS name and logos on a page for a contribution to CHAOSS GrimoireLab is the case this lock is built for; any other use, or publishing such a page outside the upstream's own review, needs permission from the CHAOSS project and The Linux Foundation, which has not been asked for or given.

notes: Fonts: GrimoireLab's site loads Lato and Montserrat from Google Fonts (docs/_includes/head.html); neither upstream repository holds their files, and the template's page allows fonts only from itself, so no font is copied and the stacks fall back to installed fonts.
Usage: the style guide asks for clear space of the logo's o and a minimum width of 54 px; the page shows the logo at 6.5rem (104 px) wide with that space around it.
